items.subject: source

review.notes: Actual pixels inspected. Shows Google Play licensing UI after launching the unmodified Hark1.0.0-36 package; no account identifiers, credentials or private content. This is an environment outcome, not Hark core UI evidence.

items.method: Normal launch after successful Google sign-in on a clean official Android35 Google Play emulator. Official listing rejected availability for this account country; unmodified signed ARM64 sideload installed but launch redirected to Google Play licensing gate. No installer spoofing, package modification, region change or licensing bypass.
limitations: REA screenshot has no automatic artifact identity; analyst bound it to the installed package/version via focused inspection and launch context.
The foreground UI is Google Play; do not infer Hark chat/card/settings geometry or behavior from this diagnostic.
